info.title: API.SH: ASDA
info.description: The ASDA API from API.SH: public ASDA data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
ASDA's category names one level at a time with product counts: without parameters the top categories; with `category` its departments; with `department` too its aisles; with `aisle` its shelves. Each row carries the parameters to browse it with /asda/v1/category.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asda-categories

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Top category name, e.g. Chilled Food.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
The products of one ASDA category, department, aisle or shelf (names from /asda/v1/categories), with the same fields, filters and facets as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asda-category

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
ASDA products on offer: Rollbacks and price drops by default, or one multibuy (`promotion`, e.g. Any 3 for 2), optionally within a category or a search, with the same fields and facets as search (the promotion facet lists every current multibuy). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asda-offers

parameters.name: offer
parameters.description: rollback, price_drop or any (default any, unless promotion is given).

parameters.name: promotion
parameters.description: A multibuy name from the promotion facet.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

products.name: Beauty 20 Collagen Powder Sticks Unflavored 20 x 5.1g

get.description:
One ASDA Groceries product: everything in search plus the prices in all four UK nations, every dietary flag, icons with images, the rating distribution, recommendation share and secondary ratings (quality, value...).

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asda-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product number at the end of an asda.com/groceries/product/... link, or that link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

example.name: British Milk Semi Skimmed 2 Pints
taxonomy_pages: Chilled Food > Milk, Butter, Cream & Eggs

get.description:
Customer reviews of one ASDA product: rating, title, text, nickname, date, recommendation, helpful votes, secondary ratings (quality, value, experience), badges, photos and ASDA's replies. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asda-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The product id or its asda.com link.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
ASDA Groceries (UK) product search in relevance order: product id, link, name, brand, pack size, price, was price, unit price, Rollback / price-drop flags, multibuy promotions with dates, New label, rating and review count, dietary flags (vegan, gluten free...), icons, country of origin, category / department / aisle / shelf with ids, sponsored, frozen and alcohol flags, purchase limit and image. Prices are for the chosen UK nation. `facets` lists brands, the four category levels, promotions, labels, icons and countries with counts (use the names as filter values). Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/asda-search

parameters.name: brand
parameters.description: Only these brands (names from the brand facet, comma-separated).

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Top category name, e.g. Chilled Food.

parameters.name: department
parameters.description: Department name, e.g. Milk, Butter, Cream & Eggs.

parameters.name: shelf
parameters.description: Shelf name, e.g. Semi Skimmed Milk.

parameters.name: dietary
parameters.description: Comma-separated: vegan, vegetarian, halal, kosher, gluten_free, lactose_free, milk_free, egg_free, nut_free, peanut_free, soya_free, fish_free, shellfish_free, sesame_free, low_fat, low_sugar, low_salt, low_saturated_fat, high_fibre, source_of_fibre.

parameters.name: promotion
parameters.description: A multibuy from the promotion facet, e.g. Any 3 for 2.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: Prices for england (default), scotland, wales or northern_ireland.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
